title: Case 1: July 2002 Break Monsoon Onset
description: Severe drought and break monsoon onset. NWP models predicted active monsoon continuation across Central India, but synoptic analogue engine detected catastrophic suppression 4–7 days ahead.

title: Case 2: July 2001 Active Monsoon Depression
description: Deep monsoon depression developing over northwest Bay of Bengal and tracking west-northwestward with heavy orographic enhancement along Western Ghats.
